_readme: Single source for The AI Treasurer Insights. Add one entry per approved article (newest anywhere; the script sorts by date), then run: python3 insights.py. It rebuilds the Home cards (latest 3), /insights/, /insights/feed.xml and the sitemap entries. Topics must be one of the listed topics.

articles.title: Your First AI Task in Treasury Should Be Unglamorous
articles.summary: Four questions to decide which tasks you can trust AI with, and which must stay with your team.
